svg.text: Everyday English - Phrasal verbs
fall through
MEANING
Fail to happen as planned.
IN CONTEXT
Our travel plans fell through at the last
minute.
USAGE NOTE
Fall through is intransitive: the deal fell
through, not we fell the deal through. It
describes an arrangement that fails to
happen; say fell through for the past.
CONVERSATION
A: Are you still taking the weekend trip?
B: No. Our plans fell through when the
booking was canceled.
A: Could you rearrange it for next month?
B: Yes. We will check dates before making
new plans.
YOUR TURN
Explain why an arrangement fell through.
Model: The agreement fell through because
the two sides could not agree on a price.
